poc_summary: 4-week Dedicated POC to validate throughput guarantees and latency SLOs for reranking and live chat. Verify reserved GPU sizing for steady-state and peak bursts, run load and soak tests, confirm KV/prefix cache behavior, and surface any kernel/quantization recommendations from Redwood Optimize.
throughput_targets: 200-400 req/s typical; up to 1k/s peak with autoscale/burst
latency_slos: p50 < 20ms; p95 < 75ms; p99 < 200ms (token generation/response time end-to-end)
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial reserved pool: 4 x A100-80GB (shared Dedicated node pool) for baseline. If soak tests indicate >20% queuing, add 2 more GPUs (target 6) and keep track of KV cache hit ratios. Consider mixed-precision int8/q4 models for cost savings; Redwood SE to provide kernel/tuning recommendations.
load_test_plan: Warmup: ramp 0->200 req/s over 10 minutes, validate KV cache warmup time
Steady-state: hold 200 req/s for 2 hours, measure p50/p95/p99 and token cost
Spike test: inject 1k req/s bursts for 2 minutes every 30 minutes
Soak test: 24h at 180-220 req/s to observe memory growth, checkpoint events, GC/compaction impact
Failure injection: kill one GPU node during steady-state to validate graceful fallback and routing policies
soak_test_results: 2026-03-03 24h run: sustained 180 req/s; p95 averaged 82ms with periodic spikes to ~140ms during backend compaction; KV cache hit ratio 74% after 3h warmup. Action: investigate KV pre-warming and batching configuration.
